_doc: Findings from `make tool-sweep` that are KNOWN and triaged, so the gate can
be green without the finding being forgotten. Each entry is still printed on
Key format: '<invariant>:<tool>'. The value is why it is acknowledged and
This file CANNOT rot: an entry that no longer matches a live finding fails
the sweep as a STALE acknowledgement, so fixing the defect forces the
acknowledgement to be deleted in the same change.
